note: The number of structural facts the transcription audit asserts against the upstream reference. The `provenance` gate measures it -- it runs verify/audit_transcription.py and reads the count out of the verdict -- and fails when it moves, because a fact added to the audit is a fact the oracle now depends on and the documentation has to say so. The `docs` gate reads this file and checks that both READMEs still quote the number, so the count cannot drift between the audit and the prose. The audit needs a checkout of the reference under _build/, which is gitignored, so the GATE that measures this number is a local one: on a CI runner the provenance gate reports `unavailable` rather than `pass`. The documentation claim is still checked there, against this pin.
